title.narrative: Impact assessment of ISO 9001 Quality Management System Certification in Brazil

description.narrative: The Development Objective is to help ensure that the ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification process is truly effective in Brazil, ensuring that certified organizations are providing confidence to actual and potential customers regarding their ability to provide conforming products and services to further enhance customer satisfaction. The Immediate Objective is to assess the effectiveness of ISO 9001 certification in brazil with a view to assisting the certification bodies and national accreditation boards to identify improvement opportunities in the certification process.
